def factor_intraday_pressure_simple(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    overnight_ret, intraday_ret = alpha_tools.decompose_overnight_intraday(df_copy["close"], df_copy["open"])
    pressure = intraday_ret - overnight_ret
    pressure_ewm = pressure.ewm(span=10, adjust=False).mean()
    pressure_ewm.name = "factor_intraday_pressure_simple"
    return pressure_ewm
description: Same core directional pressure mechanism as parent: intraday return minus overnight return captures intraday trader conviction relative to the overnight gap, exponentially smoothed (span=10). The price-volume coherence modifier is removed to reduce complexity and potential overfitting, aiming to improve RankIC while preserving the elite parent's high IC/ICIR.
